>Change CRD Compatibility Checker webhook configurations from failurePolicy: Ignore to failurePolicy: Fail now that the prerequisite Konnectivity enhancement (openshift/enhancements#1941) has been resolved.

>This ensures validation is properly enforced - operations are blocked if the webhook cannot be reached, providing higher security posture and operational confidence.
>
>Updated webhooks:

>- compatibility-requirements-compatibility-requirement-webhook

## Walkthrough This PR modifies two ValidatingWebhookConfiguration YAML manifests, changing the `failurePolicy` field from `Ignore` to `Fail` for both the compatibility requirement and CustomResourceDefinition validation webhooks, altering admission behavior when webhook calls fail. ### Changes **Webhook failurePolicy Update** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Update failurePolicy to Fail**
`pkg/controllers/crdcompatibility/bindata/assets/compatibility-requirements-compatibility-requirement-webhook.yaml`, `pkg/controllers/crdcompatibility/bindata/assets/compatibility-requirements-custom-resource-definition-webhook.yaml`|Both validating webhook manifests have `failurePolicy` changed from `Ignore` to `Fail`, removing bootstrap-related comments, so admission requests are now rejected when the webhook is unreachable or fails.| **Estimated code review effort:** 1 (Trivial) | ~3 minutes
